definitions.classification_rule: teacher CE direction uses ±1e-6 nats; exact quality is lexicographic: regret direction, then top-action correctness, then optimal-action mass outside ±0.005; both axes independently classify as improved/worse/neutral
definitions.delta_direction: S615 minus B512; negative CE is improved imitation; positive optimal mass and top-action accuracy are better; negative regret is better
definitions.optimal_set: all actions tied at maximum authenticated exact_action_margin
definitions.policy_decision: legal-masked unsearched model argmax with NumPy argmax lowest-index tie break
definitions.regret: max authenticated action margin minus chosen action margin, outcome-point scale
definitions.search_decisions: not observed; no search is rerun
definitions.source_opening_identity: used only as authenticated historical cluster; no Seed 624 crosswalk assumed

protocol_timing: The original exact-oracle analysis was computed and published in attempt 0001 before this corrected protocol record. This record is retrospective; it does not claim prospective registration or a pre-outcome freeze.
selected_population: all Seed 633 exact_root_tablebase states with authenticated outcome and legal action margins
